messages:
rachel: Dropping a quick noteprototype up for bulk-editing pools + SLO presets. Two things we heard in research: users want to apply the same min/max across multiple pools quickly, and they expect SLO presets to be savable and discoverable. Thoughts?

ben: Bulk edit is a must. Current 'apply to all' checkbox felt scary in usability test. Suggest modal that previews delta changes per pool with an opt-in per-row toggle. Keep default off.

omar: Agree on the preview. Also we should avoid showing raw GPU counts when pools have mixed hardware types. Proposal: show both "GPU count" and "equivalent vCPUs" columns so users can compare apples-to-apples.

claire: For SLO presets, users kept asking "what does this preset change?" We should include an inline short summary (e.g., "Low-latency: median 120ms, target p95 400ms") and a small view-reuse button next to the slider. Also allow naming presets and pinning favorites.

zhao: Accessibility is important for the bulk modal: keyboard nav between rows, group headings for pools grouped by region, and aria-live region for the preview totals when toggles change. The confirm button should be disabled until at least one row is selected to avoid accidental apply.

rachel: Good. On naming presets: avoid jargon. Use sample names and show estimated cost change when applied. Cost estimate needs a tooltip: "Estimate includes expected burst usage; actual cost may vary."

ben: Small copy tweak: don't call them "presets" in the UI maybe use "SLO templates"  users found 'preset' ambiguous. Template vs preset opinions?

omar: "Template" reads better for reuse. Also add a small public/private toggle for templates (team vs personal). Default to team if created in team context.

claire: UX nit: when a template is applied, we should show a transient inline banner: "Template applied to 3 pools  Undo" with minimal motion. Keeps users confident.

zhao: Technical accessibility detail: the undo must be reachable via keyboard focus and announced by screen readers. Use aria-live polite for the banner text.

rachel: Decision then: implement bulk-edit modal with per-row toggles and preview deltas, show GPU + vCPU equivalents, SLO Templates (team/personal) with naming and cost preview, disabled confirm until selection, transient undo banner with a11y affordances. Action items: @ben to wireframe modal preview, @omar to spec vCPU mapping and display, @claire to craft copy samples for templates, @zhao to draft a11y acceptance criteria.

ux-helper-bot: Card created: autoscale-bulk-edit + assignees ben, omar, claire, zhao.

rachel: Thanks all. If someone thinks template naming could cause confusion with existing rollout names call it out. Otherwise we'll move to design handoff tomorrow. :rocket:
